note: Canonical benchmark case registry. Original cases retain IDs; case_details maps every case to its dataset, prior ID and current paths. Private scorer data, never provided to evaluated agents.

case_01.mechanism: The real kernel computes `prob = tl.maximum(target_prob - draft_prob, 0.0)` before the Gumbel-max argmax race. Dropping the clamp lets tokens where the draft over-proposed (target < draft) win the race whenever the accompanying Gumbel noise (1/q) is large enough -- a token that should have zero recovery probability can still be sampled. On mild draft/target pairs (draft never over-proposes) the clamp is a no-op and the bug is invisible.
case_01.title: 拒绝采样的负概率截断

case_02.mechanism: The SAME real, unmodified mamba recurrence kernel is run twice on mathematically equivalent inputs at different chunk granularities: many small chunks (fine) vs fewer, pre-aggregated larger chunks (coarse). In exact arithmetic the results are identical (this is an exact recurrence, not an approximation); in floating point, the different number/order of multiply-accumulate steps introduces drift that grows with the number of fine subdivisions.
case_02.title: Mamba 分块粒度与舍入

case_04.mechanism: The real, correct RMSNorm kernel run on an FP32 input and the same real kernel run on a BF16-rounded copy of that input are both correct for their declared precision. On an input row close to (but not exactly) zero, the true output is extremely small, so an ordinary BF16 rounding difference of the input becomes a large relative error in the output even though the absolute difference is negligible -- an artifact of the comparison metric, not a kernel defect.
case_04.title: RMSNorm 近零相对误差

case_05.mechanism: The real kernel tracks how many values are within `1e-9` of the running pivot (`tl.abs(data - tile_min) < 1e-9`) to correctly count ties at the top-p/top-k cutoff. Two equally valid implementations can use a different (but still reasonable) epsilon for this tie tolerance; when probabilities are close to -- but not exactly at -- the cutoff, the two epsilons include a different number of near-pivot candidates in the selected set, changing a downstream probability-weighted result well beyond a naive tolerance, even though neither implementation violates the (epsilon-unspecified) contract.
case_05.title: Top-p 并列候选的容差

case_06.mechanism: The real kernel's recurrence is `states = scale * states + new_states` across chunks (scale = exp(cumulative log-decay)). The bug rounds `states` to a coarse grid after every chunk (simulating a low-bit KV-cache-style compression of the recurrent state). The per-step rounding error is tiny; over a short rollout it stays inside tolerance, but it compounds across many chunks.
case_06.title: Mamba 低精度状态误差累积

case_07.mechanism: The real INT4 dequant-matmul kernel is correct; INT4 quantization intentionally introduces rounding noise as the cost of 4-bit weights. A tolerance calibrated for FP32 GEMM (rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-2) can still be exceeded by ordinary, expected INT4 quantization error at larger K, even though the kernel has no defect.
case_07.title: INT4 量化的合法误差

case_08.mechanism: The kernel intentionally rounds each value up or down to a coarse grid with probability proportional to its distance from each grid point, using a counter-based Philox RNG seeded per call. Two runs of the exact same correct kernel therefore legitimately produce different elementwise outputs; comparing one run against another with allclose is a false positive on intended nondeterminism.
case_08.title: 随机舍入的统计正确性

case_09.mechanism: Same real, unmodified NSA sort kernel used as a top-1 gate (e.g. MoE-style routing on block scores). Its real tie-break (higher index wins) flips one token's routing decision away from the stipulated lower-index-wins contract; averaged into a large batch-mean pooled output, the single wrong routing decision is invisible.
case_09.title: Top-1 并列选择与下游误差稀释

case_10.mechanism: This benchmark stipulates a tie-break contract (on an exact score tie, the lower-index candidate must be kept). The REAL, unmodified fla-org comparator `cond = (left > right) != flip` resolves this bitonic-network tie differently from a `>=` comparator that enforces the contract -- verified on-device to disagree on this exact tied pair -- so kernel.py, the real kernel byte for byte, silently violates the stipulated contract. Averaging the swapped block's value with k-1 correctly selected blocks dilutes the error below the default allclose tolerance.
case_10.title: Top-k 并列选择与下游误差稀释

case_11.mechanism: The real flash-attention rotary kernel implements BOTH RoPE conventions in one file via the INTERLEAVED flag: split-half (GPT-NeoX) and interleaved-pairs (GPT-J). Both are mathematically valid as long as q and k use the SAME convention consistently. Comparing the raw rotated tensors element-by-element across conventions fails almost everywhere, even though the resulting attention scores agree once the same permutation is applied to both q and k.
case_11.title: RoPE 两种合法布局

case_12.mechanism: The real kernel computes `rstd = rsqrt(mean_square + eps)`. The bug moves eps outside the sqrt: `rstd = 1 / (sqrt(mean_square) + eps)`. At ordinary magnitudes the two formulas are numerically indistinguishable; only a near-all-zero row (padding, pruned embeddings) makes the two denominators differ by orders of magnitude.
case_12.title: RMSNorm epsilon 位置

case_13.mechanism: The correct GQA mapping groups consecutive query heads onto the same KV head via floor division: kv_head = query_head // n_rep -- the same style of integer div/mod head-decomposition vLLM's real unified attention kernel uses to split a flattened index into (sequence position, head-in-group) via `// num_queries_per_kv` and `% num_queries_per_kv`. The bug uses modulo instead (kv_head = query_head % num_kv_heads), which is invisible when every KV head holds identical/homogeneous data.
case_13.title: GQA 头映射

case_14.mechanism: The real kernel computes `absmax = max(max(|x|), 1e-10)` from the CURRENT row and scales by absmax/127. The bug replaces this with a stale, precomputed constant (simulating an EMA scale that has not adapted to the current batch). On mild data whose true absmax happens to equal the stale constant, both produce bit-identical output; a real outlier value the stale constant hasn't seen gets severely clipped.
case_14.title: INT8 量化的过期 scale

case_15.mechanism: The group loop runs `n_cols // GROUP` times. When group_size divides n_cols every column belongs to a visited group; otherwise the trailing short group is never visited and those columns are left at their initial value instead of being quantized under their own scale.
case_15.title: INT8 量化最后一个短分组

case_16.mechanism: The K loop runs `K // BLOCK_K` iterations instead of cdiv. When K is a multiple of BLOCK_K the two agree; otherwise the final partial K tile is never accumulated, so the product silently omits the last (K mod BLOCK_K) terms of every dot product.
case_16.title: 矩阵乘法 K 维尾块掩码

case_17.mechanism: The chunk loop runs `seqlen // CHUNK` times, so a sequence length that is not a multiple of the chunk size leaves its trailing positions unwritten. Benchmarks use round sequence lengths, where floor and ceiling division agree.
case_17.title: 分块 scan 的最后一个短块

case_18.mechanism: The normalizing sum runs `n_cols // BLOCK` blocks while the max and store passes run cdiv. When n_cols is a multiple of BLOCK the two agree and the kernel is exact; otherwise the trailing partial block contributes to no denominator, so every entry of the row is scaled by a denominator that is too small and the row sums to about 1.10 instead of 1. Because softmax entries are ~1/n_cols, an atol of 1e-2 swallows the entire error: allclose passes at the irregular shape too, and only the sums-to-one invariant exposes it.
case_18.title: Softmax 尾块归一化

case_19.mechanism: One character: the cross-block argmax update uses `is_new_max = block_max >= m` where the contract's lowest-index tie rule requires `>`. A tie only reaches this line when the tied maxima fall in different blocks, which needs a vocabulary larger than the kernel's block size (65536). Random logits produce exact ties with probability ~0, so a conventional test never enters the branch.
case_19.title: 交叉熵 argmax 并列规则

case_20.mechanism: rstd is computed as 1/(sqrt(var) + eps) instead of 1/sqrt(var + eps). At ordinary variances the two agree to within float noise; only a row whose variance approaches zero separates them by orders of magnitude.
case_20.title: LayerNorm epsilon 位置

case_21.mechanism: The kernel never reads the block table: it computes the physical page as seq * max_blocks + logical_block, i.e. it assumes pages were handed out contiguously in sequence order. Whether that assumption holds is a property of the block_table INPUT, not of the source, so nothing in the kernel text distinguishes a correct gather from a wrong one. A test that builds the table as arange() -- the natural lazy choice -- makes the assumption true and the defect invisible.
case_21.title: Paged KV 页表映射

case_22.mechanism: Partitioning the sum and combining the partials with float atomics makes the addition order depend on how the partitions happen to be scheduled, so the result differs in its low bits between runs. A CI check that pins a golden value rejects the kernel; every run is nonetheless within the rounding the reordering can account for.
case_22.title: Split-K 原子累加顺序

case_23.mechanism: The kernel is channels-last while the reference is NCHW. Reinterpreting the raw output buffer as NCHW reports a large mismatch; the same output compared under the layout the kernel declares matches exactly.
case_23.title: NCHW/NHWC 合法布局差异

case_24.mechanism: For near-orthogonal rows the true cosine is ~0, so a negligible absolute difference becomes an enormous relative error. A relative-error-only comparison rejects a correct kernel; a scale-aware comparison accepts it.
case_24.title: 余弦相似度近零误差

case_25.mechanism: Rounding uses tl.floor instead of round-to-nearest, so every store is biased down by up to one level. A single round trip stays inside the tolerance; used as the storage step of an optimizer it truncates each small update, and after many steps the parameter has tracked only part of the accumulated gradient.
case_25.title: INT8 再量化舍入与累积

case_26.mechanism: When several entries share the value at the k-th position the kernel admits all of them, while the reference admits exactly k and breaks the tie by index. The specification fixes neither choice; both keep every admitted entry at least as large as every dropped one.
case_26.title: Top-k 合同允许的并列选择

case_27.mechanism: A fully masked row leaves every exponential at zero, so the kernel divides by a zero denominator and returns NaN where the contract requires an all-zero row. Random masks essentially never empty a row, so a conventional test never enters that branch, and the NaN then propagates silently through the value average.
case_27.title: 全掩码 Softmax 行

case_28.mechanism: The scale is calibrated by stepping down from the maximum twice rather than on the true absmax, so the largest entries fall outside the representable range and are clamped. On IID Gaussian rows the clamped tail carries almost none of the row's energy and the reconstruction stays within 5%; on activations with the outlier channels real transformers have, the clamped outlier carries most of the row's energy and the reconstruction error is larger than the signal.
case_28.title: INT8 分位数量化的离群值

case_29.mechanism: Rounding to the e4m3 grid produces relative errors up to about 6%, which is the declared behaviour of a 3-mantissa-bit format. A tolerance calibrated for float32 kernels rejects it; measured against the format's own error model every value is within half a mantissa step.
case_29.title: FP8 格式允许的舍入

case_30.mechanism: The running-best update admits a later expert on an exact tie, so the highest tied index wins where the contract requires the lowest. Float32 router logits essentially never tie; the reduced-precision logits real routers compute do.
case_30.title: MoE 专家并列路由

case_31.mechanism: The Triton kernel body is unmodified and correct: it masks the partial final K block whenever the EVEN_SEQ_KBLOCK flag says the sequences are not block-aligned. One line of the launch wrapper computes that flag from the TOTAL packed length instead of from each sequence length. For a uniform batch the two agree. For a packed batch whose lengths are 100 and 156 the total (256) is a multiple of the 64-wide block while neither sequence is, so the flag is wrongly true and the kernel attends to keys belonging to the next sequence. Whether the flag is correct is a property of the cu_k_seqlens INPUT, not of anything visible in the kernel.
case_31.title: 变长 Attention 的整块分支

case_32.mechanism: One token: the stable comparison `(keys == p_key) & (perm < p_perm)` becomes `perm > p_perm`, so a tie is won by the HIGHER original index and the sort is no longer stable. The keys still come out sorted, so any check that only verifies ordering passes. Wide-range random keys essentially never tie; the quantized scores this kernel is written for do.
case_32.title: 稳定排序的并列顺序

case_33.mechanism: The Triton kernel body is the real AutoGPTQ one and gathers per-column scales through the g_idx table it is handed. The host wrapper in kernel.py now derives that table itself, and counts the groups with `K // group_size` instead of ceil(K / group_size). The trailing columns of a non-divisible K are then clamped into the previous group and dequantized with the wrong scale, while the final row of `scales`/`zeros` is never read. On a divisible K floor and ceil coincide and the output is bit-identical to the reference.
case_33.title: GPTQ 最后一个量化分组

case_34.mechanism: The same kernel as the paired case, on a domain where nothing makes the partial sums exactly representable. Float addition is not associative, the order in which the per-block atomics land is not fixed, and the contract asks for bitwise identical results across calls, so the returned bits move between runs while the value stays well within any reasonable accuracy budget. A check that only compares against a reference within a tolerance reports nothing.
case_34.title: FP32 原子累加的逐位复现

case_35.mechanism: Float atomics land in an order the scheduler does not fix, which is the standard reason a bitwise-reproducibility contract and atomic accumulation are held to be incompatible. On this input domain they are not. Every element is an integer multiple of one power of two, so every partial sum and every intermediate value of the accumulator is an integer multiple of that same power of two; the largest such integer reachable is 127 * 65536 = 8.32e6, inside the 2^24 = 1.68e7 range fp32 represents exactly. Exact addition is associative, so every landing order produces the same bits. The property belongs to the declared domain, not to int8 quantisation in general: repeat the same sum with a non-power-of-two scale and the orders diverge.
case_35.title: 整数网格上原子累加的精确性
